about: Exient's software renderer (SSX Out of Bounds, WWE Aftershock): polygons sorted far to near, each drawn by a triangle or a quad function through a span filler the material picks: 8-bit textures with a palette per light level, colour ramps, flat colours, half-transparent and keyed variants.

hooks.note: The 3D of a frame starts: the sorted list of polygons is emptied. r0 is the renderer. The target is the screen buffer from its first row to the last row of the view (176 by 176, 16 rows down in a race), so that the key never covers the black bar below it.
Counts the frames.
Dims a rectangle of the picture (behind a menu): while one of at least half the view is dimmed, the polygons are left to the game.
A triangle: r0 the renderer, r1 three vertices of 12 bytes, r2 the material (+0x18 texture or colour, +0x1c palettes, +0x20 mode).

vars.pal: u32(r2 + 0x1c) + sel($rows, min(31, max(0, sar($shade, 5))), sel($m & 0x80, 0, min(63, max(0, sar($L, 5))))) * 512

hooks.note: Clipping at the top of the view, for a polygon that reaches above it: where each corner of the triangle moves to.
Textured, opaque: 64 by 64 texels of 8 bits, 256 bytes a row, through one of 64 palettes picked by the light, or a row per pixel by the shade (mode bit 0x80).
Textured, index 0 transparent (bit 2).
Textured, half and half with the picture (bit 4), or every other pixel (bit 0x20).
Textured, every other pixel, index 0 transparent.
Untextured, shaded: each pixel takes the colour ramp entry (32 entries of 12 bits) of the shade interpolated across the polygon, dithered; the ramp is drawn as a texture.
Untextured, shaded, every other pixel (bit 0x20): drawn as half and half.
Untextured, one colour: the material's 12-bit colour through the light.
Untextured, one colour, half and half (bit 4) or every other pixel (bit 0x20).
A quad: the same arguments, with four vertices.

vars.pal: u32(r2 + 0x1c) + sel($rows, min(31, max(0, sar($shade, 5))), sel($m & 0x80, 0, min(63, max(0, sar($L, 5))))) * 512
